stories.headline: Mistral Releases Voxtral 3 Voice Agent SDK
stories.blurb: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, an open-weights voice model and SDK supporting over 50 languages, enabling developers to build low-latency, multilingual conversational agents.

stories.headline: PyTorch Introduces Native Support for TPUs
stories.blurb: PyTorch introduced TorchTPU to provide native, first-class integration for Google Cloud TPUs, streamlining high-performance AI training and inference on custom hardware.

stories.headline: Google Cloud Open-Sources Distributed Inference Stack
stories.blurb: Google Cloud released llm-d 1.0, an open-source software stack designed to simplify and optimize distributed LLM inference across heterogeneous compute clusters.

stories.headline: Perplexity Computer Runs Fully Local on macOS
stories.blurb: Perplexity released a local desktop environment for macOS that runs models directly on Apple Silicon, eliminating cloud latency and privacy risks.

stories.headline: vLLM Project Announces Humming Inference Kernels
stories.blurb: The vLLM project unveiled Humming, a suite of flexible GPU kernels engineered to significantly accelerate quantized model inference.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Ports TypeScript Compiler to Rust
stories.blurb: Cloudflare announced tsrs, an open-source Rust port of TypeScript designed to dramatically speed up compilation times and lower memory overhead for large applications.

stories.headline: Major Google Cloud Outage Knocks UK Banking Offline
stories.blurb: A cloud service disruption severely impacted financial institutions and public services across the UK, highlighting ongoing cloud resiliency challenges.

stories.headline: Researcher Removes Over 300 Malicious Tor Exit Nodes
stories.blurb: A security researcher successfully identified and purged more than 300 rogue exit nodes from the Tor network, substantially improving user privacy and network integrity.

stories.headline: Anthropic Uses Claude to Automatically Reduce Attack Surfaces
stories.blurb: Anthropic published research demonstrating how Claude can refactor application code autonomously to systematically remove security vulnerabilities.

stories.headline: WorkOS Unveils Agent-to-Agent SSO Protocol
stories.blurb: WorkOS detailed an identity federation framework for agent-to-agent SSO, defining trust and authentication standards for non-human autonomous systems.

stories.headline: Salesforce Acquires Braze for $5.66 Billion
stories.blurb: Salesforce agreed to purchase customer engagement platform Braze to consolidate its enterprise marketing cloud suite.

stories.headline: Chinese Giants Spend $35B on Nvidia Workstation GPUs
stories.blurb: ByteDance, Tencent, and Alibaba placed massive orders for export-compliant Nvidia RTX Pro GPUs to sustain AI development amid export controls.

stories.headline: Mastercard Opens Payments Rails to AI Agents
stories.blurb: Mastercard launched early access to an agent payment infrastructure that allows autonomous AI agents to conduct secure financial transactions.
